A '''swamp monster''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zeenada]]. Its [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] were the size of big rocks and they could take up entire lakes. They were extremely territorial.
